correctness.rationale: For the partial-meet nearlattice of nonempty subsets, any filter with disjoint members contains every singleton and is full; otherwise finite intersection closure forces a nonempty common generator, so all other filters are principal [K). The complement-of-generator map identifies Fi(N_n) with P([n]). Every quasi-modal operator has unique coordinate zero-locus filters with K_j arbitrary subsets; f(A)={j:K_j⊄A}, proving count 2^(n²). Principal-valued iff each nonempty A contains some K_j; either a K_j is empty or all n are distinct singletons, giving U_n=2^(n²)−(2^n−1)^n+n! and asymptotic n/2^n. Calomino (2023) Theorem 28 transfers monadic operators to Boolean quantifiers, which on a finite atomic Boolean algebra are precisely equivalence-class saturations; K_j is the equivalence class of j, so Bell B_n and unique identity representable follow. Independently re-enumerated all n=2,3 coordinate tuples: totals 16/512, representable 9/175, monadic 2/5 and one representable monadic in each. No extrapolation of finite tests to arbitrary n.
